title: Editgroup
description: An editgroup is a collection of edits to Fatcat entities proposed by an editor for review and acceptance.

editgroup_id.description: Fatcat identifier for this editgroup. Assigned on creation.

editor_id.description: Fatcat identifier of editor that created this editgroup.

changelog_index.description: For accepted/merged editgroups, the changelog index that the accept occurred at.

created.description: Timestamp when this editgroup was first created.

submitted.description: Timestamp when this editgroup was most recently submitted for review.

description.description: Comment describing the changes in this editgroup.

extra.description: Free-form JSON metadata attached to this editgroup.

edits.description: Collections of edits grouped by entity type.

edit_id.description: Unique UUID for this specific edit object.

ident.description: Fatcat identifier of the entity this edit is mutating.

revision.description: Entity revision that this edit will set the entity to.

prev_revision.description: Revision of entity just before this edit.

redirect_ident.description: Target entity identifier for redirect/merge edits.

editgroup_id.description: Editgroup identifier that this edit is part of.
